nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Go HTTP API (Nx project @gardbase/api) serving tenants/objects/encryption endpoints, backed by DynamoDB/S3 and talking to the enclave over vsock; containerized via Dockerfile.Api and pushed to ECR.

nodes.name: enclave-service
nodes.summary: Go service running inside an AWS Nitro Enclave that handles attestation, session key derivation and KMS key wrapping/unwrapping; containerized via Dockerfile.enclave.

nodes.name: landing
nodes.summary: React + Vite marketing/landing site (Nx project @gardbase/landing) built to dist/apps/landing.

nodes.name: infrastructure-bootstrap
nodes.summary: Terraform workspace (S3 backend key bootstrap/terraform.tfstate) creating the Lambda code bucket and the ECR repository consumed by the main stack.

nodes.name: infrastructure-main
nodes.summary: Main Terraform workspace (S3 backend key main/terraform.tfstate) provisioning EC2 Nitro hosts, DynamoDB, S3, KMS and CloudWatch; reads bootstrap remote state and has dev/prod tfvars.

nodes.name: crypto-sdk
nodes.summary: Standalone Go module (github.com/qodesrl/gardbase/pkg/crypto) implementing client-side deterministic/probabilistic/OPE encryption and KMS helpers; published as an SDK rather than deployed.

branches.name: main
branches.reason: Default branch (origin/HEAD -> origin/main); receives merges from test via PRs.

branches.name: development
branches.reason: Long-lived integration branch in the development -> test -> main promotion flow.

branches.name: test
branches.reason: Long-lived staging branch merged from development and promoted into main.

branches.name: infrar-test
branches.reason: Tooling branch containing a single 'infrar: import analysis' commit; not part of the development/test/main flow.
